name: streetsync-monorepo
description: StreetSync monorepo – contracts, evidence/arkiv packages, backend API, Next.js app

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@streetsync/swarm-client && npm run build --workspace=@streetsync/evidence && npm run build --workspace=@streetsync/arkiv-client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,streetsync -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=streetsync-backend" "npm run dev --workspace=streetsync-app"
scripts.dev:streetsync: concurrently -n backend,app -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=streetsync-backend" "npm run dev --workspace=streetsync-app"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@streetsync/swarm-client && npm run build --workspace=@streetsync/evidence && npm run build --workspace=@streetsync/arkiv-client && npm run build --workspace=streetsync-backend
scripts.test:pipeline: npm run test --workspace=@streetsync/swarm-client && npm run test --workspace=@streetsync/evidence && npm run test --workspace=@streetsync/arkiv-client
